description: PASS 37.1: crossover-rule audit. Appendix C states one rule; the pipeline uses three.

rules.RULE_1_predicted: anrl.theory.crossover.predict_crossover -- theory vs theory, sustained RMSE. Produces every PREDICTED n*. This is what Appendix C describes.
rules.RULE_2_measured_noisy_pure: anrl.benchmark.hardened.crossover_table -- measured vs measured, PAIRED z-test, first 'collective' verdict, not sustained. Produces the MEASURED n* of the 68 noisy-pure cells.
rules.RULE_3_measured_heldout: experiments/run_stress_test.py part 4 -- measured single RMSE vs the THEORY collective floor, sustained. Produces the MEASURED n* of the 27 held-out cells.
